crates/carrick-aarch64/Cargo.toml.source:
[package]
name = "carrick-aarch64"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true

[lib]
name = "carrick_aarch64"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[lints]
workspace = true

[dependencies]
carrick-fatal.workspace = true
# The shared aarch64 engine scaffold sits ABOVE carrick-hal/carrick-mem/
# carrick-guest-mem and BELOW the per-VMM backend crates (carrick-vmm-hvf /
# carrick-vmm-kvm's aarch64 lane). It reuses the ISA-neutral error type
# (`TrapError`), the syscall-frame type, the stage-1 page-table manager, and the
# guest-memory protection gate from those leaves; it pulls in NO backend crate
# (those depend on IT, once Stage 2+ wires callers).
carrick-hal = { path = "../carrick-hal" }
carrick-mem = { path = "../carrick-mem" }
carrick-guest-mem = { path = "../carrick-guest-mem" }
# The shared sigframe glue trades in `carrick_abi::LinuxSiginfo`; the run-elf
# service loop + fault delivery reference `libc` signal/errno numbers.
carrick-abi = { path = "../carrick-abi" }
# guest_cpu accounting (begin_active/finish_active around the guest run) so
# getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF)/times/`/proc` see the guest's CPU time. Done ONCE in
# this shared run loop — like carrick-x86.
carrick-host = { path = "../carrick-host" }
carrick-observability = { path = "../carrick-observability" }
bitflags.workspace = true
libc.workspace = true
parking_lot.workspace = true
tracing.workspace = true

[dev-dependencies]
carrick-conformance-contract = { path = "../carrick-conformance-contract" }

conformance-contracts/contracts/pristine.source:
schema_version = 1
id = "kernel.mm.pristine-scrub"
title = "Pristine anonymous ranges need no physical backing maintenance"
guest_surfaces = ["syscall:madvise", "syscall:mmap", "syscall:brk"]
semantic_authority = ["Linux anonymous memory reads zero before first write; MADV_DONTNEED preserves zero-read semantics"]
fixture = "unit:pristine-scrub"
scale_points = [1, 8, 32, 128]
rationale = "With exact-MM pristine provenance covering the full range and lazy anonymous backing enabled, maintenance need not resolve COW or write backing. Missing, partial or disabled authority preserves the existing maintenance path and errors. No inference from absent translations is permitted."
[bindings]
vm_free = "carrick-aarch64::engine::pristine_scrub::tests::pristine_scrub_contract"
[bindings.unresolved]
embed_structural = "Production pristine-range observation and signed anonymous/fork/retained-backing semantics pending."
docker = "Signed semantic oracle and workload comparison pending."
[[structural_budgets]]
kind = "affine"
metric = "host_backend_calls"
base = 0
per_unit = 0
layers = ["vm-free"]
rationale = "In this decision fixture a backend call is the combined COW preparation and physical scrub callback. Fully pristine ranges require zero such invocations."

crates/carrick-conformance-next/tests/fi.source:
import ctypes as c, os, select
lib = c.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
lib.mmap.restype = c.c_void_p
lib.mmap.argtypes = [c.c_void_p,c.c_size_t,c.c_int,c.c_int,c.c_int,c.c_long]
lib.madvise.argtypes = [c.c_void_p,c.c_size_t,c.c_int]
lib.munmap.argtypes = [c.c_void_p,c.c_size_t]

def zero(p, n):
    assert lib.madvise(p, n, 4) == 0
    assert c.string_at(p, n) == bytes(n)

for pages in [1,8,32,128]:
    n = pages*4096
    p = lib.mmap(None,n,3,0x22,-1,0)
    assert p is not None and p != c.c_void_p(-1).value
    # Two discards before any read/write; the full range is still pristine.
    assert lib.madvise(p,n,4) == 0
    zero(p,n)
    # A partially dirty range must not skip its materialized bytes.
    c.c_ubyte.from_address(p).value = 91
    c.c_ubyte.from_address(p+n-1).value = 93
    zero(p,n)
    # Child discard must not clear the parent's shared COW source.
    c.memset(p,0x5a,n)
    r,w = os.pipe()
    child = os.fork()
    if child == 0:
        try:
            os.close(r)
            zero(p,n)
            os.write(w,b'K')
            os._exit(0)
        except BaseException:
            os._exit(1)
    os.close(w)
    assert select.select([r],[],[],5)[0], 'child did not complete'
    assert os.read(r,1) == b'K'
    os.close(r)
    assert os.waitpid(child,0) == (child,0)
    assert c.string_at(p,n) == bytes([0x5a])*n
    zero(p,n)
    assert lib.munmap(p,n) == 0
    print('pristine_scrub_pages='+str(pages)+'=ok',flush=True)
